context_branches.branch_paraphrase: MUSICBOX is the edited learner output, distinct from original MUSICBOX.WKB. DateText is literal current date; Header DateCode is dynamic and document-owned. Clock/version/date must be declared.

context_branches.topic: Page numbering and invisible owner deletion
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: NewPageNumber restarts numbering; PageNumberStyle alone cannot create multiline headers. Delete invisible code requires exact caret/owner confirmation. No/Cancel refusal branches remain unrun and are not source-numbered actions.

Header editing has its own status and no ordinary document page indicator; source limits a header to one page. Automatic trailing blank line/header height reduces body space. InsertPageNumber uses special ^B owner, not literal AB from OCR. Header return and body return are distinct.

Delete old page-number suppression before adding current-page HeaderA suppression. Confirm suppressed page1 versus header onpage2 at200percent. ShiftF3 reverses preview palette and reverses back; it is not DocSwitch in preview.

context_branches.topic: Sort default and exact block boundary
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: If Sort menu is not SortByLine choose Type7 then Line2. Both lists have distinct inclusive title boundaries. These ordinary text-list sorts are not a proof of every CMD51-135 secondary-record/disk-key mode or A5ColumnMath.

Search begins backward; using SearchF2 or SearchForward menu as terminator does not authorize changing initiated direction. NotFound/typo retries steps1-2; match leaves caret after word, then HomeLeft reaches title start.
Skip proper names and acknowledge completed spell check. Save again if subsequent spelling edits should persist; print and optional preview require separate declared printer/preview evidence.

File exercise assumes harddisk setup plus extra formatted disposable disketteA; other setup uses Appendix reference, not expanded here. WBC323 replaces obsolete formatting-appendix reference with DOSmanual. F5 default directory may require OtherDirectory7; no real media/path action was performed.

NameSearch parks on matching filename; first copy is verified by changing toA then back to actual learner directory, which need not equal illustrated C path. Other existing disposableA files may vary.

context_branches.topic: Marks survive copy and destructive confirmation
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: Asterisk marking advances current selection. Copy retains marks; unmark MEMO before deleting other marked files. Two deletion confirmations are separate. Prior verified copies are source premise, not evidence of actual successful disk writes here.

MoveRename edits directory prefix, replaces existing PARK backup only on confirmation, then removes source. Marked multi-file move is unnumbered alternative. Single-file deleteMEMO and marked deletes must preserve unrelated files. No/cancel/error branches remain unrun.

WBC1351 replaces claimed fields: printed header contains currentdate/time/directory/free space; WorkbookPrinter cannot print the list, so choose actual printer. Illustrated sizes/dates are examples, not golden outputs.

context_branches.topic: Normal exit, abnormal startup and historical shell
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: NormalExit removes temporary files. Source describes abnormal-start running-instance question and stale temporary-file cleanup; never simulated or applied here. Startupbackup Rename/Delete context is separate from timedbackup recovery. WBC1637 changes historicalLibrary return example toWordPerfectOfficeShell. Pictured separateapplications and advice are documentary, not new implementation/launch obligations.

Source explicitly permits choosing individual exercises without running entire lesson end-to-end. Preserve initial state, changed defaults and restore points independently; do not fabricate one86-step continuous replay.

Changing format alone inserts no documentcode. Each inserted DateCode embeds its format; changing current format does not rewrite earlier codes. Current setting lasts untilchanged/exit; persistent initialsetting is separate. Display sample dates are not target clock values.

DOS8plus3, period truncates extension allowance, spaces disallowed; listed letters/digits/punctuation and avoidance ofCOM/EXE/BAT are source-era context. No new filename exercise or host Unicode/path policy inferred. Adapted host behavior needs separate tested contract.

ADDRESS.WKB, WorkbookPrinter and actual selectable fonts/PRS are prerequisites. Equal30-character lines atCourier10cpi versus unequal widths atHelvetica12pt distinguish print geometry from equal editing cells. WBC363 corrects prose10pt to12pt and WBC81 corrects W-line Pos7in to5.2in; i-line2.65in remains resource-specific source example.

context_branches.topic: Logical horizontal lines and optional preview
context_branches.branch_paraphrase: MUSICBOX.WKB atHelvetica10pt may have logical print lines longer than80 editing columns; HomeHomeRight/Left scroll to logical ends. Optional preview100percent/FullPage and laterlessons16/17 references are not executed or expanded.

InitialSettings changes defaults, not current-document owner alone. Example margin owner is deleted withBackspace before leaving InitialCodes. NativeSET producer obligation and hostsettings are distinct. Do not leave accidental2in default or claim any settings write occurred.

Left initialjustification is intentional lasting example. Optional per-documentFull4 requiresdocumentbeginning; source suggests repeatsteps3-4 withFull. Initialdefaults and document-specific owner need independent state restoration for subsequent exercises.

SaveF10Enter with no filename retains selected block in memory; RetrieveShiftF10Enter with no filename inserts it. Memory lasts untilapp exit. Prose about replacing memory with Enter is abbreviated: do not infer arbitrary bareEnter refresh semantics without exact UI context. MoveCopy is separate alternative.

context_branches.topic: Move via Undelete and prior deletions

WorkbookPrinterHelp thenactualprinterHelp are separate states. If no otherprinterinstalled, branch requires realresource instead of fabricated definition. HPexample inability toLineDraw proportional is resource-specific. MoreText navigation and unselectedSheetFeederHelp remain unrun.

context_branches.branch_paraphrase: OptionalPRINTER.TST print requires actual printer; no resource/test print run. This does not expand every old troubleshooting/manual reference.
